description: Symbol and instrument directory search across 66,400+ global equities, ETFs, FX pairs, indices and cryptocurrencies by company name or ticker symbol. Supports optional asset_class (equity, etf, fx, crypto, index), exchange and limit filters. Use to resolve unknown ticker symbols before calling per-ticker tools; does not fetch live prices or financial metrics.

asset_class.description: Optional asset class filter: equity, etf, fx, crypto or index

exchange.description: Optional exchange code filter, e.g. NMS, NYQ, LSE, XETRA

limit.description: Maximum number of matching instruments to return, 1-50 (default 10)

query.description: Company name or ticker prefix to search for, e.g. Apple, NVDA, S&P 500, EURUSD, Bitcoin

name: search_tickers
